python3 - <<'PY'
from unittest.mock import Mock
from larder.reminders import remind

sms, email = Mock(), Mock()
remind('+351123456789', 'member@example.com', 'tomorrow at 17:00', sms, email)
email.assert_called_once_with('member@example.com', 'Your pantry order is ready for pickup tomorrow at 17:00.')
sms.assert_not_called()
print('Reminder check passed: email delivered to member address; SMS unused.')
PY
